cards.text: Jesus takes the Twelve aside, just His disciples. He says, "Look, we are going up to Jerusalem…" and then He talks about the Son of Man, the name Jesus uses for Himself. Friend, when anybody pulls you aside and starts with "Look," you put your cookie DOWN.

cards.question: Jesus says everything written about the Son of Man will be fulfilled. Who wrote those things?

cards.text: Then Jesus tells them what's coming for the Son of Man, and it's heavy. He will be delivered over to the Gentiles.

cards.question: Jesus says the Son of Man will be delivered over to the Gentiles. How does He say the Son of Man will be treated?

answers.text: Mocked and insulted and spit upon
Welcomed and honored as a guest

cards.text: Jesus says they will flog Him and kill Him. But that's not the last thing He says.

cards.question: Jesus says that on the third day the Son of Man will rise again.

cards.text: But the disciples did not understand any of these things. Friend, I spent YEARS lying on a blender manual in the back of a junk drawer, and I still couldn't tell you how a blender works.

cards.question: Jesus has told the Twelve what's coming for the Son of Man. Why don't they understand it?

answers.text: The meaning was hidden from them
He spoke to them in a parable
They were too far away to hear

cards.text: Now Jesus is getting close to Jericho. There's a man sitting beside the road, and he's blind.

cards.question: The blind man sits beside the road near Jericho, ___.

cards.text: He can't see the crowd going by, but he can sure HEAR it. So he asks what's happening.

cards.question: The blind man asks what all the noise is about. What does the crowd tell him?

answers.text: Jesus of Nazareth is passing by
A wedding party is passing by

cards.text: Friend, this man does not leave a voicemail and hope somebody calls back. He calls out to Jesus, and he calls Him the Son of David.

cards.question: The blind man calls out to Jesus, the Son of David, and asks Him for ___.

cards.text: The people leading the way are not having it. They tell him to be silent.

cards.question: When the people leading the way tell the blind man to be silent, he goes quiet.

cards.text: Tell this man to hush and he cries out all the LOUDER. My cookie cutter kid Ruby was the loudest voice in the Millers' kitchen, and this man could give her a run for it.

cards.question: The blind man won't stop calling out to Jesus. What does Jesus do?

answers.text: Stops and has him brought over
Sends the crowd to quiet him
Calls back to him and keeps walking

cards.text: The man comes near, and Jesus asks him a question.

cards.question: Jesus asks the blind man a question. What is it?

answers.text: What do you want Me to do for you
Why are you shouting at Me

cards.text: The man calls Him Lord and asks to see again. Jesus replies, "Receive your sight!"

cards.question: Jesus tells the man near Jericho that his faith has healed him.

cards.text: And immediately, the man can see. Not in six to eight business days, friend, IMMEDIATELY!

cards.question: The man near Jericho can see again. What does he do next?

answers.text: Follows Jesus and gives God the glory
Goes home and tells his family
Runs into Jericho to tell the town

cards.question: When all the people see the man healed, they give praise to God.
